d: The results of the Bihar Assembly elections are out. Once again, an NDA government is set to be formed. The BJP is emerging as the largest party, while the RJD has slipped to the third position. Now, the leaders of the Mahagathbandhan will search for the reasons behind this crushing defeat, and meetings will be held. In any case, after this election, the RJD needs the most to rethink and strategize afresh.
